caption: Pearson correlation of each NAHB HMI signal transform (lagged L0..L12 months) with the SPY 1-month forward return. The whole grid is weak — max |r| = 0.12 — and the winner signal (nahb_hmi_diff_12m) peaks at L4 with r = +0.089, at a different lead than the deployed L7. There is no correlation ridge backing the tournament winner.
narrative_alignment_note: Winner signal nahb_hmi_diff_12m peaks at L4 (r=+0.089); values parsed verbatim from lead_correlation CSV incl. significance stars.
